hypotheses.W0_weight_bases_are_sketch_stable: Independent scale-weighted combined random-function sketches have rank-four subspace cosine at least 0.90 in at least twelve layers.
hypotheses.W1_weight_geometry_predicts_ce_subspaces: The better of QK-only, OV-only, equal-combined, and scale-weighted-combined bases exceeds its layer-matched random-subspace 95th percentile CE-basis alignment in at least twelve layers.
hypotheses.W2_scale_information_improves_weight_pre: Scale-weighted combined geometry has higher CE-basis cosine than equal-normalized combined geometry in at least ten layers.
hypotheses.W3_weight_basis_recovers_material_ce_res: The best weight-only basis achieves at least half the replication-route reconstruction fidelity of the CE-optimized rank-four basis in at least twelve layers.
hypotheses.W4_early_ce_novelty_is_visible_in_weight: At least three of L1/L2/L4/L5 have best weight-only to CE-subspace cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.W5_qk_and_ov_roles_are_distinguishable: QK-only and OV-only CE-alignment differ by at least 0.10 in at least eight layers.
